description: Source code for PyTorch's autograd profiler, including context managers, profiling configuration, and Kineto step tracking.

classes.name: profile
classes.description: Context manager for managing autograd profiler state and summarizing results.

classes.name: record_function
classes.description: Context manager and decorator for labeling code blocks in profiling.

classes.name: emit_itt
classes.description: Context manager for emitting ITT ranges for Intel VTune profiling.

classes.name: emit_nvtx
classes.description: Context manager for emitting NVTX ranges for NVIDIA profiling.

classes.name: EnforceUnique
classes.description: Class to ensure unique keys during nvprof trace parsing.

classes.name: KinetoStepTracker
classes.description: Class for managing global step count and integrating with Kineto profiler.

methods.name: _set_is_profiler_enabled
methods.description: Sets the global profiler enabled state.

methods.name: _run_on_profiler_start
methods.description: Marks the start of profiling, enabling the profiler.

methods.name: _run_on_profiler_stop
methods.description: Marks the end of profiling, disabling the profiler.

methods.name: default_trace_id
methods.description: Generates a default UUID-based trace ID.

methods.name: create_trace_id
methods.description: Creates a trace ID, optionally using a custom callback.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Returns a ProfilerConfig object with current settings.

methods.name: __enter__
methods.description: Enters the profiler context, preparing and starting profiling.

methods.name: _prepare_trace
methods.description: Prepares the profiler for tracing, recording duration.

methods.name: _start_trace
methods.description: Starts the profiling session, recording start time.

methods.name: __exit__
methods.description: Exits the profiler context, stopping profiling and processing results.

methods.name: _ensure_function_events
methods.description: Lazily processes function events if not already processed.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Returns a table of profiling results, sorted by specified criteria.

methods.name: export_chrome_trace
methods.description: Exports profiling data in Chrome trace format.

methods.name: export_stacks
methods.description: Exports stack traces of profiling events.

methods.name: toggle_collection_dynamic
methods.description: Toggles dynamic collection of activities during profiling.

methods.name: key_averages
methods.description: Returns key averages of profiling events.

methods.name: _parse_kineto_results
methods.description: Parses Kineto profiler results into function events.
